videos.title: The KEY to SMALL HAND ARMWRESTLING The BITE
videos.summary:
THE KEY to SMALL HAND ARMWRESTLING — THE BITE

If you're a shorter-armed armwrestler facing a taller opponent with a longer hand, you need to understand one fundamental truth:

You CANNOT afford to fight in a space you cannot reach.

Your opponent has a different range of movement possibilities to you. Understanding where their advantages exist, where yours exist, and refusing to engage outside your own effective range is absolutely critical.

The biggest mistake smaller-handed armwrestlers make is OVERCOMMITTING their wrist.

❌ Over-cupping
❌ Over-pronating
❌ Over-supinating
❌ Chasing positions that favour the longer lever

Every time you move beyond your effective range, you're potentially handing positional control to your opponent.

THE SOLUTION? THE BITE.

Learn to operate within just **¼ turns of your wrist**, maintaining connection, structural integrity and access to your fundamental power.

Your greatest advantage as a shorter-armed armwrestler isn't extreme wrist movement.

**IT'S YOUR POWER IN NEUTRAL.**

In this video, I break down how to recognise the boundaries of your opponent's movement, respect your own, and use THE BITE to turn a supposed disadvantage into a genuine weapon.

Stop chasing their hand. Make them fight YOUR power.
